readout_other: pre/post resting-state BOLD ROI-to-ROI functional connectivity
direction_notes: Pre-to-post amygdala sonication changed connectivity within the salience network and between salience and default-mode and frontoparietal nodes (decrease in SAN-FPN specific to amygdala); ErC sonication increased dorsal attention to default-mode and frontoparietal connectivity.
safety_notes: Participants were followed for three continuous days; no adverse events or negative reactions were reported.

timing.protocol_description: 5% duty cycle, 10 cycles of 30 s on and 30 s off for a total of 5 min of non-consecutive tFUS; 5 ms pulse width at 10 Hz PRF.

exposures.label: Left entorhinal cortex (excitatory protocol, active control target)

timing.protocol_description: 5% duty cycle, 10 cycles of 30 s on and 30 s off for a total of 5 min of non-consecutive tFUS; 0.5 ms pulse width at 100 Hz PRF.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of 20 healthy adults were enrolled in the study: 17 individuals completed both experimental sessions (4 scans), 18 individuals completed the amygdala tFUS session (2 scans), and 19 individuals completed the ErC tFUS session (2 scans).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Each participant completed two experimental sessions that were separated by exactly 2 weeks.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Both paradigms used a 5% duty cycle with 10 cycles of 30 s on, 30 s of, for a total of 5 min of non-consecutive tFUS. The amygdala target included a 5 ms pulse width repeated at a 10 Hz pulse repetition frequency (PRF), while the ErC target included a 0.5-ms pulse width repeated at a 100Hz PRF. Across both sessions, the fundamental frequency was 0.65MHz and the $\mathrm { { I } } _ { \mathrm { { s p t a . 3 } } }$ was 720mW/cm<sup>2</sup>.
